name: orchestral-monorepo
description: Orchestral — capability routing, opt-in semantic fallback, and an asset-handle protocol for AI media applications.

scripts.api:check: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "!@orchestral/dsh-plugin" exec api-extractor run && pnpm --filter @orchestral/core exec api-extractor run -c api-extractor.memory.json && pnpm --filter @orchestral/core exec api-extractor run -c api-extractor.routing.json
scripts.api:update: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "!@orchestral/dsh-plugin" exec api-extractor run --local && pnpm --filter @orchestral/core exec api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.memory.json && pnpm --filter @orchestral/core exec api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.routing.json
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm build && pnpm docs:catalog && git diff --exit-code packages/orchestral-patterns/README.md && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm api:check && node scripts/smoke-dist.mjs && pnpm -r --filter "!@orchestral/dsh-plugin" publish --access public --no-git-checks
